The Kubernetes storage class gp3 is applied through the Kubernetes provider but has no ordering edge to the cluster's aws-auth setup, which explicitly waits for EKS API readiness. Ensure cluster initialization completes before creating this Kubernetes object.

This Kubernetes storage class can be planned/applied once the EKS endpoint and auth data are available, but that does not ensure the cluster API is ready; the cluster's aws-auth resource explicitly gates on the readiness probe. Order the storage-class creation after aws-auth to avoid racing initial Kubernetes API readiness.

The gp3 Kubernetes StorageClass uses the EBS CSI provisioner, but the root configuration does not order it after the EBS CSI add-on module. Since the add-on is enabled via configuration without an attribute connection to this resource, applying the class can race the driver installation.
